summary: KB Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting that its largest shareholder, the Korean National Pension Service, experienced a decrease in share count from 33,460,006 (8.97% of 372,850,455 total shares) as of May 8, 2026, to 32,734,500 shares (9.23% of 354,687,734 total shares) as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine beneficial ownership update, not a special situation. The filing involves no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, this is a standard disclosure of a passive shareholding change. There is no actionable event for risk-arb strategies.
